name: 80135 · Sedalia, CO
findings: ZIP 80135 (Sedalia) has 30 nonprofit organizations. 13 of them (43%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 11 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (40% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 80135 (Sedalia) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 80135 (Sedalia) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.3 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 11 organizations here; 37% of all organizations here have no identified type.
